name: Hikami Shun
source:
Shun is a hidden member of the same light music club as Kōhei. [spoiler]He confuses Kōhei with his mysterious speech and actions, but his comments may hold clues to the Eternal World. [/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_One:_Kagayaku_Kisetsu_e_characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
